title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: At the PC: in the Claude app, Scheduled in the sidebar, open "LEDGER: the hourly fresh session", edit its schedule to every hour at 15 minutes past, save, then tap done. Sessions may not change a schedule themselves, and without this nothing starts between 00:15 and 05:15.
sections.recommendation: Do it when you are next at the PC; it takes about a minute. Your yes to A and B already runs. No web link: the steps are all in the app.
